profile.description: Active storytelling festival at Thanksgiving Point, but the organizer explicitly indicated Adventure Zone is not the type of attraction that fits the festival.

notes.subject: Event says Adventure Zone is not a fit
notes.body: The festival replied Aug. 18, 2026 that it 'isn't really that kind of a festival.' Current official information confirms the Sept. 10-12, 2026 event remains focused on live storytelling programs at Ashton Gardens. Treat this as a fit decline; do not repeatedly pursue unless the festival format materially changes.
